items.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
items.summary: On 18 November 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing five vulnerabilities in NGINX that allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute code with the privileges of the NGINX worker process. While researchers managed to successfully demonstrate the use of CVE-2026-123007, no exploitation in the wild has been reported yet. It is recommended to swiftly update NGINX as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing appliances.

items.title: 2026-021: High Severity Vulnerability in Java SE and OpenJDK
items.summary: On 17 November 2026, Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes for CVE-2026-114938, a high severity vulnerability in OpenJDK which could lead, under certain circumstances, in unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE). CERT-EU recommends updating vulnerable version of OpenJDK, prioritising internet facing applications.

items.summary: On 21 October 2026, GitLab published a security advisory addressing several vulnerabilities among which a critical flaw that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server. CERT-EU recommends organisations to update affected assets as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing assets, and to run an assessment to identify compromised assets.
